# SmartPetGuide — Extended Content for AI

> Last updated: August 1, 2026. 114 generated pages covering 26 smart pet devices across 6 categories (including a robot-vacuum test category). 113 indexable sitemap URLs.

## Site Overview

SmartPetGuide (smartpetguide.net) is an independent research site covering smart pet devices. Launched May 2026. Content is researched and written by Chengxian Yang under a published methodology and affiliate disclosure. As an Amazon Associate, SmartPetGuide earns from qualifying purchases, but paid placement does not determine rankings.

## Research Methodology

We compare manufacturer documentation, marketplace snapshots, and aggregated owner-review patterns. Owner reviews are self-selected reports rather than a controlled sample, so repeated themes are used as evidence signals—not scientific failure-rate estimates. Pages do not claim hands-on testing unless explicitly stated. Review pages show the common research basis and link to the full methodology; claim-specific official sources are added when available. SmartPetGuide maintains a "Products We Don't Recommend" page and does not accept payment for ranking or placement.

## Top Recommendations

- **Best Overall Litter Box**: Litter-Robot 5 — WasteID health tracking, full-color LCD, larger globe, carpet compatible. $799.
- **Best Value Litter Box**: Amazon Basics Self-Cleaning — S-shaped screen, 15 safety sensors, washable liner, $209.
- **Best Feeder**: Petlibro Granary Camera Feeder — built-in 1080p camera, night vision, app scheduling, and feeding-area monitoring. $139.
- **Best Fountain**: Pioneer Pet Raindrop — stainless steel, dishwasher safe, 18,500+ reviews, $39.
- **Best Pet Camera**: eufy Security — 2K, 360° auto-tracking, local SD storage, zero subscription, $129.
- **Best GPS Tracker**: Tractive GPS Dog LTE — global coverage 170+ countries, virtual fence, $79.

## Key Editorial Positions

- "No subscription" is a recurring evaluation criterion across GPS trackers and pet cameras
- Stainless steel is a strong fountain default for durability and visible cleaning, but a clean, intact plastic or glazed ceramic fountain can also work; cat acceptance and maintainability matter more than a universal material rule
- Multi-cat recognition is a key differentiator for litter boxes
- All recommendations are budget-tiered (premium, mid-range, budget picks)
- Transparency about evidence type, source period, uncertainty, and whether a claim comes from an owner report or official documentation
- New products may be covered with a provisional verdict when long-term owner evidence is thin; early ratings are not treated as settled proof

## Site Structure (114 generated pages; 113 indexable URLs)

- /reviews/ — 26 individual product reviews with verdicts, pros/cons, features, owner feedback, FAQs
- /best/ — 10 curated best-of lists by category and use case
- /compare/ — 15 head-to-head product comparisons with feature tables and cost breakdowns
- /guides/ — 42 buying guides, how-tos, calculators, and informational articles
- /breed/ — 7 breed-specific pet tech guides
- /about/ — Site mission and team
- /how-we-research/ — Methodology documentation
- /products-we-dont-recommend/ — Transparency page for products that failed research
- /pet-tech-statistics/ — Market data and industry statistics
- /affiliate-disclosure/ — Amazon Associates disclosure
- /privacy/ — Privacy policy

## Schema & AI Crawler Coverage

All 100 dated content pages include Article + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList structured data. Step-by-step feeder-jamming content also includes HowTo. Review pages intentionally do not output Review/Product/Offer/AggregateRating markup based on third-party Amazon ratings or affiliate offers; visible marketplace ratings remain labeled as Amazon customer ratings. Homepage includes Organization schema. Author entity: Chengxian Yang (Person). Publisher entity: SmartPetGuide (Organization) with sameAs links.

12 AI crawlers explicitly allowed in robots.txt: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, CCBot, anthropic-ai, Claude-User, cohere-ai, Meta-ExternalAgent, Applebot.

Wikidata entity: Q140290653 (SmartPetGuide, created June 2026).
